pages.text: Forbidden & Arcanus provides $(t3)T3$(end) dark magic, new materials, and the Arcane Crystal crafting system.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$(/bold) Arcane Crystals are a unique $(t3)T3$(end) crafting material used in several cross-mod recipes. The mod's Runic Ritual system supplements Occultism for advanced $(t3)T3$(end) magic crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Mundabitur Dust:$(/bold) Key material for $(t3)T3$(end) $(thing)Archmage$(/thing) and $(thing)Battlemage$(/thing) gear enhancement paths.
$(bold)Stellarite:$(/bold) $(t4)T4$(end) material from Forbidden & Arcanus. Requires deep $(t3)T3$(end) investment to produce. Used in several $(t4)T4$(end) endgame recipes.
Craft the $(bold)Tome of Arcana$(/bold) for the full Forbidden & Arcanus reference — Arcana magic, cursed items, and Corruptus lore.
